note: The Abyss resets on the 16th of each month. These are strong team archetypes for the current version, with a cheaper swap under each slot. They are hand-picked, not usage statistics.

teams.name: Stellar-Conduct
teams.note: The Cryo and Electro reaction core from Snezhnaya.

teams.name: Stellar Swirl
teams.note: Vodyanitsa lowers Anemo resistance while Odette feeds the reaction.

teams.name: Hexerei
teams.note: Witch's Homework buffs stack on Varka.

teams.name: Lunar-Charged
teams.note: Nod-Krai's Electro and Hydro reaction team.

teams.name: Lunar-Bloom
teams.note: Lauma converts Bloom into Lunar-Bloom for Nefer.

teams.name: Lunar-Crystallize
teams.note: Geo and Hydro, with Linnea healing off-field.

teams.name: Melt
teams.note: Still one of the highest single-target teams.

teams.name: Cryo and Hydro
teams.note: Escoffier shreds resistance in a two-element party.

teams.name: Vaporize
teams.note: A flexible Pyro team that needs no limited supports beyond Yelan.

teams.name: Electro hypercarry
teams.note: Mitya's Quicken team. Nahida keeps Dendro up while Baizhu heals Furina's drain.

teams.name: Freeze
teams.note: Escoffier shreds Cryo resistance; Freeze keeps enemies still.

teams.name: Mono Geo
teams.note: Four Geo units stack Geo Resonance and Xilonen's shred.

teams.name: Stellar-Conduct

teams.name: Lunar-Charged
teams.note: For bosses that punish slow single hits.
